info.description:
# Nyayavigya Unified API Collection

ONE collection covers the entire NYV API surface for every platform (NSP, NSPM, NYM, NSI, NSA, NSM, JRX). Differentiation is by SDK key, never by URL prefix.

## Variables to set
- `NYV_BASE_URL` — e.g. `http://localhost:5000` or `https://api.nyayasiddhi.online`
- `NYV_API_KEY`  — your platform SDK key (e.g. `$NYV_SDK_KEY_NSP`)
- `NYV_API_VERSION` — defaults to `v1`

## Auth
Sent as `X-API-Key` per NV-AUTH-HEADER-001.
